title: Individual Arrested for Welfare Fraud in Little Falls - NewsBreak
text:
By Staff Report ,
1 days ago The Herkimer County Sheriff’s Office Welfare Fraud Unit, assisted by the Herkimer County Department of Social Services, recently arrested the following individual for various Welfare Fraud charges.
Jason Perkov age 41 of Little Falls , NY was arrested for Grand Larceny in the Third Degree a class D Felony and Welfare Fraud in the Third Degree a class D Felony.
Perkov fraudulently received in excess of $ 6,200.00 worth of benefits in which he was not entitled to receive over a period of 8 months.
Perkov was processed on the charges and arraigned in the City of Little Falls Court in front of Judge Brinski. Perkov was released on his own recognizance with instructions to re – appear in City Court at a later date.
